titulo: GoDaddy (Feb 2023): $1.27 billion in buybacks, about 550 jobs cut. The math.
caption:
GoDaddy (Feb 2023): $1.27 billion in buybacks, about 550 jobs cut. The math.

From the archive: Feb 2023. Not today's news.
GoDaddy, Feb 14, 2023 (GoDaddy, Form 8-K (Item 2.05)): "to reduce future operating expenses and improve cash flows of the Company through a combination of a reduction in force and a rationalization of its portfolio"
GoDaddy's Form 8-K, filed Feb 14, 2023, reports an authorized restructuring plan and a reduction in its current workforce of approximately 550 employees, roughly 8% of its employees.

Same year: $1.27 billion in buybacks, 2023, company-wide. $1,270.2 million paid to repurchase Class A common stock in 2023, company-wide (cash flow statement, in millions); GoDaddy pays no dividend.
The math: $1.27 billion in buybacks (2023) ÷ about 550 job cuts = about $2.3 million in buybacks per job cut.
This is a ratio, not a payment and not a cause: the total spent on buybacks divided by the job count. The $1.27 billion is GoDaddy's total spent on buybacks in 2023, company-wide, from its 10-K cash flow statement. GoDaddy pays no dividend. We are not saying one paid for the other.

A ratio, not a cause. GoDaddy has not linked the buybacks to the cuts.

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Synthetic voice. Sources: SEC EDGAR · GoDaddy, Feb 14, 2023; SEC EDGAR · GoDaddy, Feb 29, 2024.
